description: ONE property, 365-day snapshot within a tight radius of the exact address: past storm history (up to 365 days back, not the full archive) plus current forecast risk. Give an address with county+state, or lat/lon. For the FULL 2003-present multi-peril archive use get_property_storm_history_report instead -- that tool searches a wider 5-mile radius by default, so its counts won't match this one; different time window AND different search radius, that's expected, not a data conflict.

county.description: County name without the word 'County', e.g. Dallas.

name: get_address_report
title: Property snapshot (365-day storm history + forecast)
